title: ODEBrain: Continuous-Time EEG Graph for Modeling Dynamic Brain Networks
claim: Prior recurrent models forecast dynamics in discrete steps; ours models a continuous latent trajectory through a vector field.
layout: 3 panels, left-to-right, shaded forecast region shared across plots
description: A three-panel horizontal figure under the title 'Forecasting for exploration of neuronal population dynamics'. The left panel shows real multichannel EEG traces in black, split into an 'Observed' segment and a red 'Forecasting' segment, with a curved red arrow linking them and axes labeled Channel and Time. The middle panel plots 'Latent state' against time as a staircase of grey nodes joined by horizontal and dotted vertical segments, which stands for discrete recurrent updates. A pink shaded region marks the forecast window. The right panel plots a smooth black curve through nodes, laid over a field of grey flow arrows, with the forecast window shaded pink. Captions below read 'Continuous EEG recordings', 'Discrete forecasting (recurrent-based)' and 'Continuous forecasting (ODE-based)'. The eye goes first to the contrast between the blocky staircase and the smooth curve.
caption: (Left) Continuous EEG real-time neuronal activity recordings. (Mid) Recurrent-based methods employ discrete modeling. (Right) ODE provides a continuous representation for forecasting neuronal population dynamics.
abstract: Modeling neural population dynamics is crucial for foundational neuroscientific research and various clinical applications. Conventional latent variable methods typically model continuous brain dynamics through discretizing time with recurrent architecture, which necessarily results in compounded cumulative prediction errors and failure of capturing instantaneous, nonlinear characteristics of EEGs. We propose ODEBRAIN, a Neural ODE latent dynamic forecasting framework to overcome these challenges by integrating spatio-temporal-frequency features into spectral graph nodes, followed by a Neural ODE modeling the continuous latent dynamics. Our design ensures that latent representations can capture stochastic variations of complex brain states at any given time point. Extensive experiments verify that ODEBRAIN can improve significantly over existing methods in forecasting EEG dynamics with enhanced robustness and generalization capabilities.
